entries.note: The milestone the parser makes of the page's Pickup Date (PUD in its legend).
The page's shipment status, which names the destination's state and ends with the day it was set; the parser keeps that day as the milestone's date.
The milestone the parser makes of the page's Out for Del day (OFD in its legend).
The milestone the parser makes of the page's DEL Date, in green on the page.
